pages.text: They are taller than villagers, grey, with eyes like amethyst and gold on their brows. Their cities stand around stepped ziggurats: sandstone and gold, deepslate, clean stone. Their roofs are prismarine.$(br2)They keep to their cities, busy, talking among themselves in a tongue I cannot follow.

pages.title: What Became of Them
pages.text: Their sandstone cities are the desert temples. Their deep cities are the ancient cities under the slate. Their harbours drowned into the ocean ruins. Their clean stone is the jungle temples, mossed over.$(br2)The villagers have their bones. Not much else.
